entities.name: Always-on PDU session indication
entities.description: Information element used by the network to inform the UE whether a PDU session is established as an always-on PDU session.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that makes decisions about PDU session characteristics and includes relevant information elements in messages.

entities.name: Network decides to inform about always-on PDU session
entities.description: Condition where the network determines that the UE should be informed about the always-on nature of a PDU session.

relations.description: The network includes the always-on PDU session indication IE in messages when the condition is met.
The inclusion of the always-on PDU session indication IE is conditional upon the network's decision to inform the UE.
